def parse_shared_strings(z):
    try:
        ss_xml = z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')
        root = ET.fromstring(ss_xml)
        strings = []
        # Each <si> has one or more <t> elements
        # Some are rich text (<r><t>...</t></r>)
        for si in root.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}si'):
            # gather all text elements inside si
            t_elems = si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')
            text = "".join(t.text for t in t_elems if t.text is not None)
            strings.append(text)
        return strings
    except KeyError:
        return []

def get_sheet_targets(z):
    rels_xml = z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels')
    root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)
    ns = {'rels': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'}
    targets = {}
    for rel in root.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}Relationship'):
        r_id = rel.attrib.get('Id')
        target = rel.attrib.get('Target')
        targets[r_id] = target
    return targets

def col_letter_to_index(col_str):
    exp = 0
    idx = 0
    for char in reversed(col_str):
        idx += (ord(char) - ord('A') + 1) * (26 ** exp)
        exp += 1
    return idx - 1

def parse_cell_ref(ref_str):
    # split reference into col letters and row number (e.g. "B23" -> ("B", 23))
    i = 0
    while i < len(ref_str) and not ref_str[i].isdigit():
        i += 1
    return ref_str[:i], int(ref_str[i:])

def parse_sheet_rows(z, sheet_xml_path, shared_strings):
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/' + sheet_xml_path)
    root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
    
    # We find sheetData
    ns = {'main': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
    sheet_data = root.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheetData')
    
    rows = {}
    for row in sheet_data.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
        row_num = int(row.attrib.get('r'))
        row_cells = []
        for c in row.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}c'):
            cell_ref = c.attrib.get('r')
            cell_type = c.attrib.get('t', 'n') # default is number
            
            v_elem = c.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}v')
            val = None
            if v_elem is not None:
                raw_val = v_elem.text
                if cell_type == 's': # shared string
                    idx = int(raw_val)
                    val = shared_strings[idx] if idx < len(shared_strings) else raw_val
                elif cell_type == 'str': # inline string
                    val = raw_val
                else: # numbers etc.
                    val = raw_val
            
            col_letter, r_num = parse_cell_ref(cell_ref)
            col_idx = col_letter_to_index(col_letter)
            row_cells.append((col_idx, val))
        
        # Sort row_cells by col_idx
        row_cells.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        rows[row_num] = row_cells
        
    return rows

        shared_strings = parse_shared_strings(z)
        sheet_targets = get_sheet_targets(z)
        
        # Parse xl/workbook.xml to map sheet name to r_id
        wb_xml = z.read('xl/workbook.xml')

        r_id = None

        rows = parse_sheet_rows(z, sheet_rel_path, shared_strings)

        max_col = 0
        for r in rows.values():

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import csv
import os

def parse_shared_strings(z):
    try:
        ss_xml = z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')
        root = ET.fromstring(ss_xml)
        strings = []
        # Each <si> has one or more <t> elements
        # Some are rich text (<r><t>...</t></r>)
        for si in root.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}si'):
            # gather all text elements inside si
            t_elems = si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')
            text = "".join(t.text for t in t_elems if t.text is not None)
            strings.append(text)
        return strings
    except KeyError:
        return []

def get_sheet_targets(z):
    rels_xml = z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels')
    root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)
    ns = {'rels': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'}
    targets = {}
    for rel in root.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}Relationship'):
        r_id = rel.attrib.get('Id')
        target = rel.attrib.get('Target')
        targets[r_id] = target
    return targets

def col_letter_to_index(col_str):
    exp = 0
    idx = 0
    for char in reversed(col_str):
        idx += (ord(char) - ord('A') + 1) * (26 ** exp)
        exp += 1
    return idx - 1

def parse_cell_ref(ref_str):
    # split reference into col letters and row number (e.g. "B23" -> ("B", 23))
    i = 0
    while i < len(ref_str) and not ref_str[i].isdigit():
        i += 1
    return ref_str[:i], int(ref_str[i:])

def parse_sheet_rows(z, sheet_xml_path, shared_strings):
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/' + sheet_xml_path)
    root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
    
    # We find sheetData
    ns = {'main': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
    sheet_data = root.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheetData')
    
    rows = {}
    for row in sheet_data.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
        row_num = int(row.attrib.get('r'))
        row_cells = []
        for c in row.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}c'):
            cell_ref = c.attrib.get('r')
            cell_type = c.attrib.get('t', 'n') # default is number
            
            v_elem = c.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}v')
            val = None
            if v_elem is not None:
                raw_val = v_elem.text
                if cell_type == 's': # shared string
                    idx = int(raw_val)
                    val = shared_strings[idx] if idx < len(shared_strings) else raw_val
                elif cell_type == 'str': # inline string
                    val = raw_val
                else: # numbers etc.
                    val = raw_val
            
            col_letter, r_num = parse_cell_ref(cell_ref)
            col_idx = col_letter_to_index(col_letter)
            row_cells.append((col_idx, val))
        
        # Sort row_cells by col_idx
        row_cells.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        rows[row_num] = row_cells
        
    return rows

def export_sheet_to_csv(xlsx_path, sheet_name, out_csv_path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(xlsx_path, 'r') as z:
        shared_strings = parse_shared_strings(z)
        sheet_targets = get_sheet_targets(z)
        
        # Parse xl/workbook.xml to map sheet name to r_id
        wb_xml = z.read('xl/workbook.xml')
        wb_root = ET.fromstring(wb_xml)
        r_id = None
        for elem in wb_root.iter():
            if elem.tag.endswith('sheet'):
                name = elem.attrib.get('name')
                if name.lower() == sheet_name.lower():
                    r_id = elem.attrib.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
                    break
        
        if r_id is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Sheet '{sheet_name}' not found in {xlsx_path}")
            
        sheet_rel_path = sheet_targets[r_id]
        # target might be relative like "/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" or "worksheets/sheet1.xml"
        if sheet_rel_path.startswith('/xl/'):
            sheet_rel_path = sheet_rel_path[4:]
        elif sheet_rel_path.startswith('xl/'):
            sheet_rel_path = sheet_rel_path[3:]
        
        print(f"Parsing worksheet XML: xl/{sheet_rel_path}")
        rows = parse_sheet_rows(z, sheet_rel_path, shared_strings)
        
        # Write to CSV
        max_row = max(rows.keys()) if rows else 0
        max_col = 0
        for r in rows.values():
            for c_idx, _ in r:
                if c_idx > max_col:
                    max_col = c_idx
        
        with open(out_csv_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f_csv:
            writer = csv.writer(f_csv)
            for r_num in range(1, max_row + 1):
                row_data = [""] * (max_col + 1)
                if r_num in rows:
                    for col_idx, val in rows[r_num]:
                        row_data[col_idx] = val
                writer.writerow(row_data)
        print(f"Exported {xlsx_path} -> {sheet_name} to {out_csv_path}")

# Export reference sheet
export_sheet_to_csv('LBO_Model_FY2025_Interest_Coverage_Reference.xlsx', 'LBO Model Reference', 'lbo_reference.csv')

# Export LBO Model worksheets
export_sheet_to_csv('4. Model/LBO Model/Project Vanguard - 11.20.2025 - LBO Model_v1.xlsx', 'Assumptions', 'vanguard_assumptions.csv')
export_sheet_to_csv('4. Model/LBO Model/Project Vanguard - 11.20.2025 - LBO Model_v1.xlsx', 'LBO Model', 'vanguard_lbo_model.csv')
